excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: Hey, since cancun is still an upcoming fork, flag `--latest-fork Cancun` is needed to force the filler to look for cancun tests

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: This should also unlock the `ShanghaiToCancunAtTime15k` fork

excerpts.author: jwasinger
excerpts.content: do you have this working with geth as the backing client?
